status: Declared before generating or inspecting the 120 new confirmation fields
reason: User requested a larger independent fluid test after the 12-field pilot left the history benefit over present measurements unresolved.
physical_protocol: Unchanged fluid/protocol.json: 18^3 periodic incompressible Navier-Stokes, nu=0.2, dt=0.02, two-unit burn, 12-unit response. New seeds only; identical initial clones.
model_rule: No refitting, rescaling, hyperparameter selection, feature changes, or outcome-driven seed removal. Hash frozen models and physical sources before production.
primary_target: Integrated energy normalized by each field's intervention-time energy, changed minus unchanged forcing, over time 0..8; two intervention arms per field.
primary_statistic: Mean across fields of history RMSE minus present-only RMSE. Within each field, RMSE uses the abrupt and gradual intervention targets.
primary_success_rule: The upper endpoint of the paired, whole-field bootstrap 95% interval for the mean RMSE difference is below zero. Otherwise improvement remains unresolved by this test.
secondary_diagnostics: Relative mean RMSE reduction and paired interval
Fraction of fields with lower history error
scope: Independent confirmation conditional on the fixed model family, small original training set, global flow summaries, laminar periodic regime and forcing interventions. It is not evidence for a new fluid memory law, a complete-state Markov violation, or transfer of Josephson physics. The 12-field pilot remains a separate exploratory result.
